checks.detail: DocxPackage caches original XML trees; the source index traverses original element children including markers/wrappers. compatible returns existing nodes instead of cloning or flattening their identity. Paragraph/table construction requests source using ctx.source and the original node. Story queue deduplicates kind/part/note identity; no display id or text-derived locator is used.

Closed source shape requires a captured part and a nonempty bounded path with explicit sparse-array rejection. Independent path-index/UTF-8 label budgets remain bounded alongside old body budgets; notice output forbids source. Main-thread Worker validation checks vocabulary and captured-part membership, not an independent reparse of XML; parser/oracle evidence is a different layer.

Only rendered paragraph/table controls can register; shared predicate excludes standalone and omission-only notices, permits real empty paragraphs and supported content mixed with visible omission notices. Cell excerpt buttons do not invent a paragraph location; opening actual detail mounts the real nested blocks. Whole-table and whole-paragraph disclosure explicitly includes undisplayed windows/fragments.

Story, block segment, long paragraph part, table window, cell detail/back transitions withdraw synchronously before navigation. Confirmation checks exact live source/control owner/block plus actual preview membership. New same-file prepared identity makes loaded.prepared stale and unmounts the old view before the new parse is shown; old sources stay retired.

interactionBlocked is excluded from the reading effect dependencies; it applies inert and synchronous control/source guards without pausing ready content or restarting capture. Registration during child-first layout replay permits a fresh source only for the selected exact owner/block/document; user events still require mounted/current state. Cleanup only retires the same live source, preventing a late old cleanup from clearing another selection.

The original cancel emitted available:false then unconditionally focused the old button. A synchronous withdrawal callback could hide the view first. Final withdraw clears selected before callback; cancel rechecks allowed and no newer selection after callback; focus separately requires current ownership and a connected button, with preventScroll. Cancel only removes the candidate and cannot mutate a saved opinion; stale cancel cannot remove another block source.

The layout repair adds min-height:0 and overflow:auto to document-preview. It bounds the flex child and keeps its controls inside a local scroll region; other existing inner scroll containers and content are retained. Full-App browser verification belongs to verification; screenshots viewed here show the narrow window detail and mixed/hidden content with the opinion editor reachable.
